page.layout: One block of text: a title "Errata." in italic capitals at top, then a list of errata lines in columns (signature, page, line, wrong reading, corrected reading), then an italic line "In principio libri secundi.", then a second list of errata lines. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: The first line of the second list is set in two lines: "Quinqueiae. / rucent." on the left and "Quiqueiae / ruent" on the right. The "D" signature is a black-letter-style capital. The word "recassent" is read as "recaffent" with a long s; given as printed "recassent" with uncertainty about the double-s form. Small specks and show-through are omitted.
